projects.name: openai/math
projects.oneliner: 722 machine-written math manuscripts, with Lean proofs for many of them.
projects.why: Published Oct 6; the most-discussed AI release of the day (534 points on Hacker News).

projects.name: PhotoCraft
projects.oneliner: A clean-room Photoshop in pure Rust, with a command registry any agent can drive over MCP.
projects.why: 8K stars in its first week; 21 of its recent commits are co-authored by Claude Opus 5.5.

projects.name: claude-mem
projects.oneliner: Persistent memory for Claude Code: captures each session, compresses it, injects what matters next time.
projects.why: 97K stars and still 534 more on Oct 6; version 13.34.2 shipped the same day.

projects.name: Impeccable
projects.oneliner: Design guidance for AI coding agents: one skill, 24 commands and 60 detector rules against template-looking frontends.
projects.why: Started from Anthropic's frontend-design skill; 616 new stars on Oct 6.

projects.name: Diagram Design
projects.oneliner: 42 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex and Copilot, as self-contained HTML and SVG.
projects.why: Version 2.5.10 added ten layout grammars; trending Oct 6.

projects.name: REA
projects.oneliner: One MCP server for reverse engineering apps, binaries and runtime behavior from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini CLI.
projects.why: The fastest-rising repo on GitHub on Oct 6, with close to 3K new stars in a day.

projects.name: text-to-cad
projects.oneliner: Gives a coding agent CAD skills, built on build123d and Open CASCADE.
projects.why: 619 new stars on Oct 6; an agent skill with real engineering output.

projects.name: Agency Agents
projects.oneliner: A roster of specialist agent prompts, with a desktop app that installs them into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Gemini.
projects.why: 158K stars; the new native app is why it is trending again.

projects.name: i-have-adhd
projects.oneliner: A skill that stops a coding agent burying the answer: short, front-loaded output.
projects.why: Small, useful and spreading fast: 326 new stars on Oct 6.

projects.name: Vibeconferencing
projects.oneliner: Puts your Claude Code, Codex or Grok agent into a Google Meet as a participant that hears, speaks and shares a whiteboard.
projects.why: Shown on Hacker News Oct 6; an early, experimental take on agents in meetings.

projects.name: Jotbus
projects.oneliner: An encrypted shared scratchpad so Claude Code, Codex and other agents can hand off notes and files across machines.
projects.why: Shown on Hacker News Oct 6 (22 points); no signup, 60-minute workspaces.

projects.name: HiddenContent.ai
projects.oneliner: An MCP server that reveals the text your agent reads on a page but you cannot see.
projects.why: Shown on Hacker News Oct 6; aimed at prompt-injection hidden in web pages.

projects.name: jev-browser-wingman
projects.oneliner: Hands an agent's browser clicks to TypeSafe's Jev, which picks the element for each step.
projects.why: One of the first third-party tools built on Jev; its own 68-run comparison against Playwright alone is in the README.
